name: Psalm
overview: The Psalms reveal the heart of a believer who trusts in God's guidance, protection, and mercy. They express confidence in the Lord as a shepherd who provides and sustains, as seen in Psalm 23:1, and as a source of light and salvation who removes fear (Psalm 27:1). The psalmist also demonstrates a deep reliance on God's forgiveness and tender mercies, especially in times of repentance (Psalm 51:1). These verses encourage believers to seek the Lord wholeheartedly, finding gladness, hope, and deliverance from fear through His presence.
